title: Ekiweebwayo Ekyakyusa Enkomerero
intro: Mu nnaku ez’olubereberye ez’obuntu, emmeeme yawaayo ekirabo n’ebigendererwa ebirongoofu. Kyokka, obuggya bwakweka mu kisiikirize ky’okukkirizibwa. Zuula emboozi y’omuntu ono ng’okutya Katonda n’enkomerero ye ey’ekikangabwa tebifa mu kubikkulirwa okw’obwakatonda.
clues: Nnali omu ku milembe gy’abantu egyasooka ennyo.
Nawaayo ekiweebwayo eri Mukama wange, ne kiyanirizibwa n’ekisa.
Ekiweebwayo kya muganda wange kyagaanibwa, era obuggya bwamuzikiza omutima.
Namugamba nti, ‘Bw’ongolola omukono gwo gye ndi okunzita, sijja kugolola mukono gwange kukutta; mazima ntya Allah, Mukama w’ensi.’
Nnafuuka omukosefu w’ekikolwa eky’obutemu ekyasooka ku nsi.
Omusaayi gwange gwakaaba, era nze omujulizi eyasooka olw’obutaliiko musango.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Ekiweebwayo kye kyakkirizibwa, ekyaleetera muganda we obuggya n’okumutta
Yasuuliddwa mu kyokero ekiyaka omuliro kyokka n’avaayo nga tafunye buzibu
Yazimba emmeeri ennene ennyo ng’alagirwa Katonda
Yamira ekyennyanja ekinene n’asigala mu kizikiza
Yakulembera abantu be okuyita mu nnyanja eyawukana
trial.answer: Ekiweebwayo kye kyakkirizibwa, ekyaleetera muganda we obuggya n’okumutta

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Ettemu eryasooka mu byafaayo; muganda we yasalirwa omusango
outcome.answer: Ettemu eryasooka mu byafaayo; muganda we yasalirwa omusango

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
